headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a blowout loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the New York Yankees secured a win over the Washington Nationals. The Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles, and the Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds. In other news, the Athletics placed Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list due to a right thumb capsule sprain.

Several players have been affected by injuries, with Nick Kurtz, Zack Gelof, and Mick Abel joining the injured list. Konnor Griffin was transferred to the 60-day injured list, while Kyle Harrison and Victor Bericoto were placed on the 15-day and 10-day injured lists, respectively. Jake Irvin was transferred to the 60-day injured list, and Mark Vientos was placed on the 10-day injured list.

The Chicago White Sox made a midseason trade, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in a separate trade, while the New York Mets received RHP Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with the Tigers dominating the game from start to finish. Derek Hill led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs suffered a 4-0 loss to the Cincinnati Reds, marking their final score. Hunter Greene led the Reds' pitching effort with 7.0 innings pitched, 12 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Nick Kurtz on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics first baseman Nick Kurtz has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right thumb capsule sprain. The injury is retroactive to July 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.
